title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Employee Self-Service agent for HR and IT questions and tasks
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing, approval requirement and listed controls are supported by Microsoft documentation. Minor corrections should clarify the audience wizard and sandbox recommendation, acknowledge conflicting guidance about Teams blocking, and identify checklist controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: The Employee Self-Service agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot answers workplace policy questions and acts on HR and IT tasks.
claims.quote: The Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot expedites answers for the most common workplace policy-related questions and takes action on key HR and IT related tasks

claims.claim: Disabling the connector consent prompt is not available as a self-service setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Employee Self-Service SSO connector consent disable self service configuration rollback declarative ALM. Opened /copilot/employee-self-service/publish; its consent section explicitly says this setting isn't currently available as a self-service configuration.

claims.claim: Organizations request disabling the consent prompt through a Microsoft 365 admin center support request.
claims.quote: Submit a support request through the Microsoft 365 admin center. In your request, specify that you want to disable the SSO consent form for the Employee Self-Service agent and authorize the connection on behalf of all users.

claims.claim: Declarative agent lifecycle management has no built-in approval flows.
claims.quote: Searched: Employee Self-Service SSO connector consent disable self service configuration rollback declarative ALM. Opened /copilot/employee-self-service/declarative-agent-publish and read ALM search excerpts; both explicitly state ALM has no built-in approvals.
